---
title: "Clustering dataset: exploratory data analysis"
format: html
---

```{r setup}
#| message: false
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
```

```{r load}
source(here::here("proj/munge/01_cluster_prep.R"))
```

## Overview

```{r overview}
glimpse(indiv_cluster_df)
```

```{r summary}
summary(indiv_cluster_df)
```

Number of individuals: `r nrow(indiv_cluster_df)`

Missing values per variable:

```{r missing}
indiv_cluster_df |>
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "n_missing") |>
  filter(n_missing > 0) |>
  arrange(desc(n_missing))
```

---

## Trip volume and distance

```{r vol-dist-hist}
indiv_cluster_df |>
  select(n_trips, total_distance, share_long_trips) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, fill = "steelblue", colour = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

---

## Modal choice

```{r modal-choice}
indiv_cluster_df |>
  count(modal_choice) |>
  mutate(
    mode = case_when(
      modal_choice == 1 ~ "Walk",
      modal_choice == 2 ~ "Cycle",
      modal_choice == 3 ~ "Car driver",
      modal_choice == 4 ~ "Car passenger",
      modal_choice == 5 ~ "Bus",
      modal_choice == 6 ~ "Rail",
      modal_choice == 7 ~ "Other"
    ),
    pct = n / sum(n) * 100
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(mode, n), y = pct)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "% of individuals") +
  theme_minimal()
```

---

## Mode shares

```{r mode-share-dist}
indiv_cluster_df |>
  select(share_walk, share_cycle, share_car_driver, share_car_pass,
         share_bus, share_rail, share_other) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "mode", values_to = "share") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = share)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", colour = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ mode, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Share of trips", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Mean mode shares across individuals:

```{r mode-share-means}
indiv_cluster_df |>
  summarise(across(c(share_walk, share_cycle, share_car_driver, share_car_pass,
                     share_bus, share_rail, share_other),
                   mean, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "mean_share") |>
  arrange(desc(mean_share))
```

---

## Trip purpose mix

```{r purpose-dist}
indiv_cluster_df |>
  select(share_work, share_education, share_escort_educ,
         share_shopping, share_escort, share_leisure) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "purpose", values_to = "share") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = share)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "coral", colour = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ purpose, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "Share of trips", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

Mean purpose shares across individuals:

```{r purpose-means}
indiv_cluster_df |>
  summarise(across(c(share_work, share_education, share_escort_educ,
                     share_shopping, share_escort, share_leisure),
                   mean, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "mean_share") |>
  arrange(desc(mean_share))
```

## Correlations

```{r correlations}
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 8
cluster_vars <- indiv_cluster_df |>
  select(n_trips, total_distance, share_long_trips,
         share_walk, share_cycle, share_car_driver, share_car_pass,
         share_bus, share_rail, share_other,
         share_work, share_education, share_escort_educ,
         share_shopping, share_escort, share_leisure)

cor_matrix <- cor(cluster_vars, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

cor_matrix |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("var1") |>
  pivot_longer(-var1, names_to = "var2", values_to = "correlation") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = var1, y = var2, fill = correlation)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "tomato", mid = "white", high = "steelblue",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
